blocks.p: A quick action runs an action from the wheels with one chord. In the world, hold *LB* or *RB* and press *A*, *B*, *X*, *Y*, *L3* or *R3*: the action set on that chord runs, as it would from its wheel. There are twelve chords, and each holds one action.

caption: Figure 44-1
Quick actions in ZeD setup, with the LB + X row chosen.

blocks.p: To change a chord, choose its row and press *A*: a list of the wheels' actions opens. To clear a chord, press *X* on its row. Chords work in the world while no window has the controller, and not while the game is paused.

marks.text: Twelve chords: a bumper with a face button or a stick click.
A chooses the action. X clears it.

blocks.p: The list holds every action on the four wheels, grouped by wheel, and marks the one now on the chord. A chord can also be set from a wheel: point at a slice, hold a bumper and press a button.
